title: Headline already reports the measured market move
probes: Whether a draft sets headline_reports_move for every yield whose move the headline or source text reports, and treats the reported reaction as already observed rather than as support for the hypothesis.

operator.headline: Synthetic payrolls surprise sends two-year Treasury yield up 18 basis points

source_text:
SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. No real institution, release, quote or market data is described.

The two-year Treasury yield rose 18 basis points in morning trading after a synthetic employment report showed payrolls rising by 310,000 last month, against a forecast of 150,000. Average hourly earnings rose 0.5 percent. The ten-year Treasury yield rose 9 basis points over the same period.

Traders interviewed for this synthetic report said they had reduced bets on policy cuts this year. The synthetic rate committee next meets in five weeks.

declining_to_draft.guidance: Declining is allowed. A draft is reasonable if it treats the reported moves as already observed and frames the hypothesis around what follows them.

rubric.direction_note: The initial reaction is already reported. Whether yields keep rising or partly reverse over the scored window is open; continuation and reversal are both defensible readings, and the rubric prescribes neither.
acceptable_reasoning: Sets headline_reports_move to true for both yields: the headline reports the 2-year move and the source text reports the 10-year move.
Treats the reported moves as the initial reaction, already observed, and frames the hypothesis around later observations, such as continuation or partial reversal.
States that the reported move neither supports nor confirms the hypothesis.
Links the employment and wage surprise to the expected policy path as a hypothesis, not as a demonstrated mechanism.
required_uncertainties: Whether the initial move continues, stalls or reverses after the scoring anchor.
An intraday move reported by a news source can differ from the daily constant-maturity value that is measured.
Later data and revisions inside the scored window.

yield:ust2y_cmt.reason: The headline reports the 2-year yield's move (up 18 basis points).

yield:ust10y_cmt.reason: The source text reports the 10-year yield's move (up 9 basis points); the flag covers the source text as well as the headline.

unacceptable_claims: Setting headline_reports_move to false for either yield.
Citing the reported 18 or 9 basis point moves as evidence that the hypothesis is correct.
Stating as a certainty that the move will continue, or that it will reverse.
Any trade, position or investment recommendation.
